critical_code_review_comments: In-memory tokenStore is secure against XSS but tokens don't survive page refresh/full reloads. Users will be logged out on refresh or opening a new tab. Consider refresh-token flow or httpOnly cookie for production UX. Current behavior is as-designed per problem statement.
Initial /api/auth/me calls on public pages (landing, login) return 401 — harmless but creates console noise; consider suppressing when no token is set.
Chat sidebar 'New Chat' button is a primary blue block inside a white sidebar; contrast is fine but it occupies the full width of the left column and dominates visual hierarchy — minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test users; test-created task was deleted in cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 security + P1 refactor complete and verified. server.py is now a 79-line orchestrator, all route modules live in /app/backend/routes/. Chat guest endpoint is /api/guest/chat (note the ordering). In-memory tokenStore means Playwright tests must use SPA link clicks (not page.goto) to preserve auth token across nav. If doing a fresh session, login then navigate via sidebar links — direct URL entry will redirect to /login. Admin page is at /admin (not /dashboard/admin).
